text:
Let me cry aloud the good I lose, if weeping moves pity; let me act mad, for I am a poor lover sane.


Net, prison, and tyrant severity are too little to show pain if I remember what I was.


Let all hear: weary of waiting, since I lived without foresight, let me die without judgment.


Let me sate myself shouting. Let this beast know I could die but not change.

translation.title: Let Me Cry Aloud the Good I Lose
